## Summary and motivation

Describe the problem, proposed change, and related issue. Keep the PR focused.

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Dependency update

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests (`pytest -q`) where applicable
- [ ] Dashboard build (`cd dashboard && npm run build`) where applicable
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Mobile/desktop screenshots for UI changes
- [ ] Manual reproduction steps included where useful

## Security and privacy review

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, real customer events, or unsafe fixtures committed
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, and tenant boundaries considered
- [ ] New dependencies and external network calls documented
- [ ] Demo events are distinguishable from live security events

## Architecture and operations

Describe API/schema changes, migrations, deployment effects, monitoring, and rollback steps. Link an ADR for significant cross-cutting decisions.

## Reviewer notes

Call out assumptions, known limitations, and areas where feedback is requested.
